title: CheckRequest
description: Which checkout to check, which checks to run there, and how long each may take.

folder.description: The folder that holds a checkout of the code: inside the project, and given relative to it or in full.

items.description: The name of one check, as describe lists it.

checks.description: The checks to run; left out, every check runs. A name the toolchain does not have is refused.

timeLimitSeconds.description: How long one check may run before it is stopped and its verdict is inconclusive; left out, the toolchain's own limit applies.
